content:
Is there a plan to upstream https://github.com/kbuzzard/ClassFieldTheory/tree/main/ClassFieldTheory to mathlib?
About the abstract formalism of class formations, I have developed #42687 which allows to phrase the axioms by using only the Galois cohomology of finite extensions, so that it should interact quite well with the results that have been formalized about the cohomology of finite groups. In #42687, there is a sorried definition of the class formation that is responsible for local class field theory: it should not be too hard to do the same for global class field theory.

There is a lot of material there which should be upstreamed, but there is nobody who is focussed on doing it. This was a student project from last year but now it is mainly being maintained by @Edison Xie .

Remember that sorried definitions can now go in our new Wanted directory!
I should say that I can quite believe that it would be possible to get all of local class field theory into mathlib.
Yes there is definitely plans to upstream the useful results! But lately I’m a bit carried away by continuous group cohomology, I’ll soon resume the upstream process
Meanwhile, do we have roadmap of GCFT in Tau Ceti?
There is https://github.com/roed-math/TauCetiRoadmap/pull/6 but this should not affect the work of others who want to upstream things to mathlib.
Does this +20000 line PR contain formalised statements of the main theorems of CFT in a way suitable for the Wanted directory of mathlib?
